p_definition: P = N_ab / total from channel_counts.npz key {sid}_N_ab_train_N_ab_train (verbatim on-disk key with duplicated suffix)

naming_rules.rule: three distinct quantities with non-interchangeable names (C4)
naming_rules.full_expected_nll: complete E_Q[-log2 P]; its only legal value here is the string "infinity" because Q places positive mass on P-zero cells
naming_rules.conditional_finite_support_mean: seeded MC mean over non-hit samples only (posterior cell nonzero); never call it full NLL
naming_rules.truncated_common_support_cross_entropy: cross entropy summed over common-support cells only (P>0); never call it full cross entropy

mc_plan_frozen_in_manifest.zero_hit_policy: samples whose true-symbol posterior cell has probability zero are counted separately; finite statistics are computed over non-hit samples only

1M.full_expected_nll_derivation: E_Q[-log2 P] = infinity because positive Q mass (q_mass_on_p_zero_cells > 0) sits on cells where log2(P) = log2(0) = -infinity, so the sum contains mass * (-infinity) summed negatively to -infinity.

conditional_finite_support_mean.definition_note: seeded MC mean over non-hit samples only (posterior cell nonzero); never call it full NLL

truncated_common_support_cross_entropy.definition_note: cross entropy summed over common-support cells only (P>0); never call it full cross entropy
